By popular demand:
A follow-up thread on Russian bots, Yandex, Cloudflare, MAGA, AfD and "breathing easier" on social media.

1️⃣ We see no "dramatic drop" in traffic of Kremlin-aligned human trolls-for-hire targeting Russian domestic users (which we have been tracking for years).

Here’s X posts by hour for posts containing “AfD” from Oct 5 thru Oct 13. Time is in Pacific. My understanding is that first impact would be around 2:30pm PDT on Oct 7, and second 6-8pm PDT on Oct 10. I don’t see any significant decrease in X traffic around these times or during this period at all.
I could be wrong, and I’m happy to read other analyses or look at other data. I can run analyses on other conversations (on X). But I’m just not seeing it.

Y’all, I hate to rain on the dead bot parade, but the Yandex data center destruction doesn’t seem to have significantly impacted social media bots. I made temporal graphs of X posts about AfD around the time of the attack and there’s no sign of a sudden dip or residual impact on that conversation.
